question:
Spot the erroneous part, if any, in the following sentences.

Glycogen, a __substance related to__ (A) / __starch and sugars__, is found in the Fungi (B) / and __Cyanophyceae as a food reserve__. (C) / __No error__ (D)
solution:
The correct answer is 'B.'

• The error lies in Part (B) of the sentence.
 
• Sugar is an uncountable noun and is not used in the plural.
 
 
• Example: *Don't eat too much sugar.*
